description: This file defines a class 'HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_HTML_ID' responsible for validating HTML 'id' attributes within the HTMLPurifier library. It includes methods for checking the validity of an ID based on configurations, prefixes, and blacklists, and interacts with context and accumulator objects to manage IDs.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_HTML_ID
classes.description: Class for validating the HTML 'id' attribute, ensuring IDs are valid and conform to configuration rules, including prefixing and blacklist checks.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the given 'id' string based on configuration settings and context; manages prefixes, blacklist, and ID accumulator.
